items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: There was a four-piece band and Teddy Weatherford was playing the piano.

ctx.x: Do you remember where you heard Kepler?

Yes, I heard it was a place on 35th Street, I think 35th and Prairie. Jimmy Noon was in the band. There was a four-piece band and Teddy Weatherford was playing the piano. Oh, yeah. And I think Tubby Hall was playing the drums. They used to start about one o'clock in the morning. Because they really hear some music around Chicago then. We're down in New Orleans right now. There's no music down here.
Nothing like there used to be.
